'''Clue scroll (elite)''' is a [[cryptic clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (elite)|elite]] [[Treasure Trails]].

When searching the chest, the chatbox message "The chest is locked! The inscription on the chest has been blazed off with flame." is displayed, hinting that you must kill the [[King Black Dragon]] to get the key.
